messages:
taylor: quick heads up — Marketing + Product want to coordinate a short embargoed blog mention and social push tied to the benchmark post. Reporter asked for early access and a quote. any constraints?
sophia: timeline?
taylor: reporter asked for quote by tomorrow 10am, and offering embargoed preview for Monday publish. they said `can we get an image or benchmark summary`.
elaine: we can provide a one-paragraph summary + approved quote. legal needs to sign off on the language and the graphic (no model names that imply certification).
ben: Product can assemble a single-slide summary image (latency/cost highlights) and a short 2-line blurb about Redwood Dedicated performance.
sophia: draft quote I propose: `Redwood Inference welcomes independent performance analyses that reflect real customer workloads. Our focus is enabling reliable, cost-effective inference at scale for engineering teams.`
legal-bot: [automated] flagged phrase `real customer workloads` for review — please confirm intent.
elaine: replying to legal-bot: yes that wording is intentional; it clarifies we mean production-style usage not synthetic microbenchmarks.
ben: updated slide to avoid phrasing that could be read as a certification. removed product logos from the asset.
sophia: requested legal signoff on final quote and the slide.
legal-bot: [automated] checks complete: no IP or export issues, cleared for embargoed preview.
press-bot: [automated] please add embargo window to press tracker and confirm contact info.
elaine: added embargo window: embargo until Mon 09:00 PT; requested 24h heads-up before publish. tracker link: https://drive.google.com/xyz (internal). contact: press@redwood.ai
taylor: offering a 15-min background call with product/engineering if reporter wants deeper detail; DMing reporter now.
ben: also added tweet-ready language and recommended asset sizes to the tracker.
sophia: quick note — keep the quote product-neutral, offer Dedicated as follow-up on the call.
elaine: agreed. sending final quote and slide under embargo.
press-bot: [automated] thread marked resolved by taylor at 1839991470
